target_customer: Robotics engineers and robotics companies building robots with ROS or similar middleware
problem: Robot middleware such as ROS has slow communication performance and painful debugging, slowing development and reliability.
business_model: Open source robot middleware, with paid tooling implied (Studio, Hindsight early access); pricing not stated

founders.name: Lakshay Sharma
education: University of Pennsylvania, computer engineering, astrophysics and robotics
founders.background_notes: YC page says he researched robot motion planners at MIT.

founders.name: Se Hwan
founders.background_notes: YC page gives no last name or further background.

technical_complexity.rationale: A zero copy, cross platform middleware that stays compatible with ROS 2 is systems engineering with hard performance and compatibility problems, built by two robotics PhDs.

defensibility.rationale: ROS is entrenched and open source, and Zenoh was being adopted as an alternative ROS 2 middleware in 2024, so a new open source middleware has weak lock-in unless it wins developer mindshare.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The ROS community moved toward Zenoh as an alternative middleware by 2024 and 2025, which covers part of the same wedge; no acquisition of Cerulion found.

market_need_then: ROS 2 users reported discovery overhead and network setup pain with DDS, prompting Open Robotics to evaluate alternatives, as shown by the 2024 rmw_zenoh work.

identity.visual_style: Robot arm and humanoid imagery on the site
identity.voice_and_tone: Technical and benchmark driven: 'Bring your robot'

brand_strength.rationale: Invented name with no explanation and no press about the brand found; the project is early and open source.

pivots.from: Open source robot middleware to replace ROS
pivots.to: Open source runtime and harness that lets AI agents control robots, ROS 2 compatible
pivots.why: Not stated; the YC page and current site describe different positioning.

outcome_analysis: Cerulion is a two person open source robotics middleware company from YC S24 that has shifted toward a runtime for AI agents controlling robots. It claims large communication speedups and users at Amazon Robotics and Boston Dynamics AI Institute, unverified. No funding could be verified, and the middleware space is shaped by ROS 2 and Zenoh, so traction is unclear.
notes: Aggregators say about $500K total (VCBacked: pre-seed Sep 2024 with Y Combinator, SBXi and Scale Asia Ventures; CB Insights lists a business plan competition Oct 2025); not confirmed by a primary source so not recorded as rounds. StartupHub's 2020 founding date conflicts with YC 2024 and is ignored. Competitor search returned Zenoh, Viam and Apex.AI from 2024 to 2026 pages, but none was from a source dated near the batch about these as competitors of Cerulion, so the list is empty. Completeness pass: the 2024-09 pre-seed (about 500K) rests on a single database (VCBacked) and the 2025-10-16 business plan competition round (no amount) on a single database (CB Insights). Crunchbase shows a seed entry with Soma Capital but obfuscated; a second search did not confirm Scale Asia Ventures. No press total found.
